ends in /viewform, not a forms.gle short link: short links cannot be
To find it: open the form, click Send, choose the link tab, and UNTICK
Leave a url empty and the site quietly falls back to GitHub issues for
that one, so nothing breaks while you are still setting the forms up.
topicField is optional. Give it the entry id of a short-answer question
in the feedback form and every topic on the site gets its own feedback
link that arrives with the topic name already filled in. To find the id:
open the form, click the three dots, 'Get pre-filled link', type anything
into that question, click 'Get link', and copy the entry.123456789 part
out of the URL it gives you.

suggest.label: Submit a paper
suggest.blurb: Know a paper that belongs in the review? Send it here — you will need its INSPIRE control number and a sense of which physics and quantum information topics it sits between. No GitHub account required.

feedback.label: Feedback and suggestions
feedback.blurb: Report a misclassified paper, suggest a new category, or point out an error anywhere in the review or on this site. To add a paper, use the form above instead.
